blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke cell ki do bunyadi (basic) qismein (kinds) hain, prokaryotic aur eukaryotic. Tamam bacteria prokaryotes hain. Yeast aur Euglena yak-khalvi (unicellular) eukaryotes ki misalein hain; poday aur janwar kaseer-khalvi (multicellular) eukaryotes hain. Eukaryotic cells prokaryotic cells se zyada pecheeda (complex) hain. Yeh topic cells mein maujood banawat (structures) aur un ke kaam (functions) parhata hai.
Cell wall

Cell wall cell ke gird kam-o-besh thos (solid) tah (layer) hai. Yeh bacteria, fungi, podon aur algae mein milti hai. Jab cell wall ko wall torne wale enzymes se hata diya jaye to cell ke baqi hisson ko protoplast kehte hain.

Primary wall cell ki asal cell wall hai. Yeh polysaccharides se bani hai: cellulose, hemicellulose aur pectin. Cellulose ke microfibrils har zaviye (angle) par tarteeb-diye hote hain aur hydrogen bonds se jure hote hain. Primary walls mein bohat se proteins bhi hote hain. Middle lamella ek jelly jaisi tah hai jo parosi (neighbouring) cells ki primary walls ko alag bhi rakhti hai aur jore bhi rakhti hai. Yeh sab se pehle banti hai, cytokinesis ke dauran cell plate se, aur phir primary cell wall middle lamella ke andar phailti hai. Is mein magnesium aur calcium pectates (pectic acid ke namak) hote hain. Kuch poday ke cells mein, pukhta (mature) hone ke baad, protoplast aur primary wall ke darmiyan ek secondary wall banti hai. Secondary cell walls mein lignin, cellulose aur hemicellulose hote hain; lignin ki wajah se secondary wall primary wall se zyada sakht (rigid) hoti hai.

blocks.title: Plasmodesmata (wahid plasmodesma)
blocks.text: Chhote channels jo parosi poday ke cells ke cytoplasm ko seedha jorte hain. Yeh primary aur secondary dono cell walls ke aar-paar hote hain aur kuch molecules ko ek cell se doosre tak seedha guzarne dete hain, is liye cell ke rabte (communication) mein aham hain. Yeh cell ki taqseem (division) ke dauran bante hain jab parent cell ke endoplasmic reticulum ke hisse nayi cell wall mein phans jate hain.

blocks.alt: Do poday ke cells saath-saath aur un ki mushtarak wall cross-section mein: bahar se andar, darmiyan mein middle lamella, har taraf primary wall jis mein cellulose microfibrils mukhtalif zaviyon par hain, gehri secondary wall, phir har cell ki plasma membrane. Ek channel (plasmodesma) tamam tahon ko paar kar ke dono cytoplasm ko jorta hai, aur us ke andar ER ka ek dhaga hai.
blocks.caption: Do parosi poday ke cells ki walls aur ek plasmodesma (Figures 3.5 aur 3.6 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Magnesium aur calcium pectates ki middle lamella sab se pehle banti hai aur dono cells mein mushtarak hoti hai. Phir har cell middle lamella ke andar cellulose, hemicellulose aur pectin ki primary wall banata hai, aur pukhta hone ke baad us ke andar lignin wali secondary wall. Plasma membrane wall ke andar ki taraf hoti hai. Plasmodesma membrane se ghira channel hai jo wall ki tamam tahon mein se guzar kar ek cell ke cytoplasm ko doosre se jorta hai.

blocks.title: Cell theory par ek behas
blocks.text: Plasmodesmata ne scientists mein behas paida ki hai: kuch kehte hain ke aala (higher) podon ke cells asal mein alag cells nahin, kyunke woh jismani taur par ek doosre se alag ya azaad nahin.

Cell walls ke kai kaam hain. Yeh cell ko banawat aur mechanical sahare ke liye sakhti deti hain; cell ki shakal aur numu (growth) ki simt (direction), aur aakhir mein poday ki poori banawat qaim rakhti hain; jab pani cell mein dakhil ho to cell wall phoolne se rokti hai; yeh pathogens aur mahol (environment) se hifazat karti hai; aur poday ke liye carbohydrates ka zakheera (store) hai.

blocks.caption: Mukhtalif groups mein cell walls
rows: Cellulose, hemicellulose aur pectin (primary); secondary walls mein lignin shamil
Silica, jo cell ke andar silicic acid ko polymerise kar ke bahar nikali jati hai; tawanai mein sasti, is liye diatoms tez barhte hain
Chitin, wohi carbohydrate jo keeron (insects) ke exoskeleton ko mazboot banata hai
Peptidoglycan, amino acids aur sugar ka ek bara polymer
Mukhtalif polysaccharides aur proteins; peptidoglycan nahin

blocks.text: Plasma membrane

Tamam prokaryotic aur eukaryotic cells ki plasma membrane hoti hai jo un ke andar ki cheezon ko ghere rakhti hai aur bahar ke mahol ke liye neem-masamdar (semi-porous) rukawat (barrier) ka kaam karti hai.
Plasma membrane ki banawat

Fluid mosaic model woh aam taur par tasleem-shuda (accepted) tasawwur hai jo plasma membrane ki badalti (dynamic) fitrat bayan karta hai. Ise do American biologists, S. J. Singer aur Garth Nicolson, ne 1972 mein pesh kiya. Fluid mosaic model ke mutabiq plasma membrane ki bunyad phospholipids ki bani lipid bilayer hai, aur is bilayer mein proteins ka ek majmua tairta (floats) hai.

Har phospholipid ke molecule ke ek sire par phosphate group hota hai. Phospholipids apne phosphate sire par hydrophilic ("pani-pasand") aur apni tails mein, jin mein C-H chains hoti hain, hydrophobic ("pani se darne wale") hote hain. Plasma membrane ki lipid bilayer mein hydrophobic tails andar ki taraf hoti hain aur hydrophilic phosphate groups bahar ki taraf, cytoplasm ya cell ke bahar ke mahol ki simt.

Eukaryotes mein plasma membranes ke phospholipid bilayer mein cholesterol ke molecules phanse hote hain; yeh kam darja-hararat (temperature) par membrane ko rawan (fluid) rakhte hain. Bohat se proteins bilayer ke andar tairte hain, jabke kuch doosre proteins sirf us ki satah se chipke hote hain. Proteins ki jagah cytoskeleton ki tarteeb se juri hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Plasma membrane ka cross-section: phospholipids ki do qatarein jin ke neele sar bahar aur peeli tails andar ki taraf hain. Is mein baen se daen ek channel protein jis mein surakh hai, ek carrier protein, ek receptor protein jis se bahar ki taraf ek paigham-rasan (messenger) molecule jura hai, andar ki satah par ek peripheral protein, tails ke darmiyan phansa cholesterol ka molecule, aur bahar sugar chain wala ek glycoprotein. Baen taraf chhoti sugar chain wala ek glycolipid hai.
blocks.caption: Plasma membrane ka fluid mosaic model (Figures 3.7 aur 3.8 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Phospholipid bilayer ke hydrophilic sar dono taraf pani ki simt hain aur hydrophobic tails andar. Proteins bilayer mein tairte hain: channel proteins aur carrier proteins mawad transport karte hain; receptor proteins hormones jaise messengers se jurte hain; peripheral proteins membrane ko cytoskeleton se jorte hain; glycoproteins aur glycolipids bahar ki taraf sugar chains rakhte hain jo pehchan ke nishan hain. Tails ke darmiyan phansa cholesterol thand mein membrane ko rawan rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Plasma membrane ke proteins kai mukhtalif tareeqon se kaam karte hain.

items: Bohat se proteins kuch mawad ko phospholipid bilayer ke paar chun kar (selectively) transport karne mein kirdar ada karte hain, channels ya active transport molecules ke taur par.
Kuch proteins plasma membrane ko cytoskeleton aur bahar ke fibres se jorne mein madad karte hain.
Bahar ki satah par kuch proteins sugars se jur kar pehchan ke nishan (identification marks) banate hain.
Doosre proteins receptors ka kaam karte hain, jo paigham-rasan molecules (jaise hormones) se jurte hain aur signals cell ke andar pohanchate hain.
Kuch proteins enzyme ka kaam bhi karte hain aur plasma membrane se mutalliq mukhtalif reactions ko tez (catalyse) karte hain.

blocks.title: Membrane ko proteins kyun chahiye
blocks.text: Lipid bilayer ka andar hydrophobic hai aur pani mein hal hone wale (water-soluble) molecules ko guzarne nahin deta. Agar cell sirf khalis lipid bilayer mein band hota to pani mein hal hone wale molecules jaise sugars aur polar amino acids bilkul na guzar paate. Isi liye phospholipids ke ilawa membranes mein proteins hote hain jo membrane ke paar raste dete hain.

Plasma membrane ki bahar ki satah par sugars ki chains proteins aur lipids se juri hoti hain. Sugar jura protein glycoprotein hai; sugar jura lipid glycolipid hai. Glycoproteins aur glycolipids nasl (species) se nasl, ek hi nasl mein fard (individual) se fard, aur ek hi fard mein ek cell type se doosre tak mukhtalif hote hain. Inhen mila kar glycocalyx kehte hain, aur yeh cell ki pehchan ke nishan hain jinhen doosre cells pehchante hain.

blocks.title: Pehchan ke nishan kyun aham hain
blocks.text: Mukhtalif cells mein farq karne ki salahiyat zindagi ke liye nihayat zaroori hai. Is se embryo ke cells khud ko tissues aur organs mein tarteeb dete hain, aur immune system ke cells ajnabi (foreign) cells, jaise infection phailane wale bacteria, ko pehchan kar radd (reject) karte hain.
Plasma membrane ke kaam

Plasma membranes bahar ke mahol ke liye neem-masamdar rukawat hain. Membrane ek had (boundary) ka kaam karti hai jo cell ke ajza ko saath rakhti hai. Yeh khaas molecules ke liye guzarne-dene wali (permeable) hai: ghizai ajza aur doosre zaroori anasir ko cell mein aane aur fuzla (waste) ko bahar jane deti hai. Chhote molecules jaise oxygen, carbon dioxide aur pani azadi se membrane ke paar jate hain, magar bare molecules jaise amino acids aur sugars ka guzarna ehtiyat se qaboo kiya jata hai. Eukaryotic cells ke kuch andaruni organelles ke gird bhi membranes hoti hain; plasma membrane ki tarah yeh bhi organelles ke andar-bahar mawad ki rawani qaboo karti hain.
Plasma membrane ki banawat parhne ki techniques

items: Transmission electron microscopy lipid bilayer aur us se jure proteins ki tafseeli banawat dikhati hai.
Scanning electron microscopy cells aur membranes ki satah ki shakal (topology) dekhti hai.
Confocal microscopy laser scanning aur fluorescence se cell membrane ke saaf, tafseeli images banati hai.
Total internal reflection fluorescence microscopy membrane aur cytoskeleton tatha doosre cell ajza ke saath us ke taalluq ki high-resolution images deti hai.
Atomic force microscopy cell membrane ki satah ki high-resolution images deti hai.
X-ray crystallography membrane proteins ki atomic banawat maloom karti hai.
Lipidomics membrane ke lipids ka mukammal tajziya (analysis) hai, mass spectrometry jaisi techniques se.

Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching membrane proteins aur lipids ki harkat aur dynamics parhti hai: membrane ke ek fluorescent-labelled hisse ko laser se bleach kiya jata hai aur dekha jata hai ke fluorescence kaise wapas aati hai jab bleach na hue molecules us jagah aate hain.

blocks.caption: Membrane ki tarkeeb, wazan ke lihaz se fisad (textbook table ke mutabiq)

blocks.text: Cytoplasm aur organelles

Cell teen bare hisson par mushtamil hai: plasma membrane, cytoplasm aur nucleus. Cytoplasm ek neem-gaarha (semi-viscous), neem-shaffaf (semi-transparent) madda hai. Eukaryotic cells mein yeh plasma membrane aur nuclear envelope ke darmiyan hota hai; prokaryotic cells mein yeh plasma membrane ke neeche ki poori jagah bharta hai. Yeh ek pani-numa bunyadi madde, cytosol, par mushtamil hai jis mein mukhtalif organelles aur doosri cheezen hoti hain. Cytosol pani hai jis mein bohat se organic madde (proteins, carbohydrates, lipids) aur inorganic namak poore ya juzvi taur par hal hote hain. Cytoplasm organelles ko theek kaam karne ki jagah deta hai aur mukhtalif biochemical (metabolic) reactions ki jagah hai, maslan glycolysis, aerobic respiration ke dauran glucose ka tootna.

Cytoplasm mein alag-alag banawat hoti hain jo mukhtalif cell ke kaamon ke liye makhsoos hain, yeh cell organelles hain. Organelles aam taur par membrane mein band hote hain, siwaye chand ke jaise ribosome.

blocks.alt: Ek mustateel (rectangular) poday ka cell jis ki moti bahari cell wall aur us ke andar plasma membrane hai. Ek bari central vacuole darmiyan bharti hai. Nucleus apne nucleolus ke saath ek taraf dhakela hua hai, aur us ke qareeb rough ER aur smooth ER hain. Teen chloroplasts jin mein discs ke dher hain, do mitochondria, ek Golgi stack, azaad ribosomes, ek peroxisome aur wall mein se guzarta plasmodesma label kiye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Poday ke cell ki ultrastructure (Figure 3.9 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Poday ka cell plasma membrane ke bahar cell wall mein band hai. Is ki bari central vacuole zyada tar jagah leti hai aur nucleus ko ek taraf dhakel deti hai. Nucleus do-tah envelope mein hai aur nucleolus rakhta hai. Ribosomes wala rough ER aur smooth ER nucleus ke qareeb hain; Golgi apparatus khameeda (curved) sacs ka dher hai; mitochondria ki andaruni membrane moori hui hai; chloroplasts mein thylakoids ke dher hain. Ribosomes cytoplasm mein bikhre hain, peroxisome ek chhota single-membrane jism hai, aur plasmodesma wall ke paar parosi cell tak jata hai. Centrioles nahin hain.

blocks.alt: Ek gol janwar ka cell jo sirf plasma membrane se ghira hai. Nucleus apne nucleolus ke saath darmiyan mein hai. Rough ER ek taraf nucleus se laga hai aur smooth ER doosri taraf. Do mitochondria, ek Golgi stack, do lysosomes, ek peroxisome, ek chhoti vacuole, azaad ribosomes, nuqtedar cytoskeleton ki lakeerein aur seedhe zaviye par centrioles ka jora label kiye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Janwar ke cell ki ultrastructure (Figure 3.10 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Janwar ke cell mein na wall hai na chloroplasts. Nucleus darmiyan mein hai. Ribosomes se jara rough ER aur un ke baghair smooth ER nuclear envelope se jure hain. Golgi apparatus mahsoolat (products) pack karta hai; lysosomes mein hazam karne wale enzymes hain; peroxisomes mein oxidative enzymes; vacuoles chhoti hain; mitochondria ATP banate hain. Centrioles ka jora nucleus ke qareeb seedhe zaviye par hai, aur cytoskeleton ke protein fibres cytoplasm mein phaile hain.

blocks.text: 1. Nucleus

Tamam eukaryotic cells mein ek numayan nucleus hota hai: janwar ke cells mein darmiyan, poday ke cells mein ek taraf dhakela hua. Gol nucleus aam taur par eukaryotic cell ke hajm (volume) ka taqreeban 10 fisad leta hai. Yeh cell ka maloomat ka markaz aur intezami (administrative) markaz hai aur do bare kaam karta hai: cell ka wirasati (hereditary) mawad (DNA) mehfooz rakhta hai aur cell ki sargarmiyan, jaise numu, protein synthesis aur cell division, ko mutawazan (coordinate) karta hai. Nucleus ke andar ka neem-rawan madda nucleoplasm hai. Is mein zyada tar nuclear mawad chromatin hai, jo cell division ke dauran tarteeb pa kar chromosomes banata hai. Nucleus mein ek ya zyada nucleoli bhi hote hain, jo ribosomes banate hain.
Nuclear envelope aur nuclear pores

Nuclear envelope do tahon wali membrane hai jo cell ki zindagi ke zyada tar hisse mein nucleus ke andar ki cheezon ko ghere rakhti hai. Dono tahon ke darmiyan ki jagah, perinuclear space, rough endoplasmic reticulum se juri hai. Cell division ke dauran nuclear envelope toot jati hai, magar daughter cells mein dobara ban jati hai. Envelope ke andar ki taraf protein ki ek tah, nuclear lamina, hoti hai jo chromatin se jur kar use sahara deti hai.

Nuclear envelope mein nanhe surakh, nuclear pores, hote hain jo nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan molecules ke guzarne ko qaboo karte hain. Nuclear pores chhote molecules ko guzarne dete hain, aur kuch bare proteins, jaise histones, ko bhi nucleus mein aane dete hain. Nuclear pore ek pecheeda banawat, nuclear pore complex, se bana hai jis ke kai subunits hain: annular subunit (pore ke andar ko ghere), column subunit (complex ki deewar banata), ring subunit (column subunit ke bahar se jura) aur lumenal subunit (pore complex ko nuclear envelope mein jamata). Complex se aam taur par nanhe fibrils nikal kar nuclear side par tokri (basket) jaisi banawat banate hain.

blocks.title: Nuclear envelope ke paar kya jata hai
blocks.text: DNA aur RNA ke building blocks, aur ATP, nucleus mein dakhil ho sakte hain. Nucleoli mein bane ribosomal subunits un cheezon ki misal hain jo nucleus se nikal kar cytoplasm mein jati hain.

blocks.alt: Cross-section mein ek gol nucleus: do membranes ki envelope jin ke darmiyan halki perinuclear space hai, envelope mein narangi (orange) khalaon ke taur par chaar nuclear pore complexes, andar nuqtedar nuclear lamina, nucleoplasm mein lehradar chromatin fibres, ek gehra gol nucleolus, aur daen taraf bahar ki membrane se jari ribosomes wala rough ER.
blocks.caption: Nucleus, us ki envelope, nuclear pore complexes aur nucleolus (Figures 3.11 se 3.13 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Nuclear envelope do membranes hain jin ke darmiyan perinuclear space hai; bahar ki membrane rough ER se jari hai. Nuclear pore complexes dono membranes ke aar-paar hain aur andar-bahar ki aamad-o-raft qaboo karte hain, nuclear side par fibrils ki tokri ke saath. Nuclear lamina, envelope ke andar protein ki tah, chromatin ko jorti hai. Nucleoplasm mein bikhra chromatin (histone proteins ke saath DNA) aur nucleolus hai, jo nucleolus organiser regions par ribosomal subunits jorta hai.

blocks.text: Nucleolus

Nucleolus nucleoplasm mein ek numayan, gehra stain hone wali banawat hai; ek nucleus mein ek ya do nucleoli ho sakte hain. Nucleoli woh subunits banate hain jo mil kar ribosomes banate hain. Yeh chromosomes par khaas jagahon, nucleolus organiser regions (NORs), par bante hain; NORs ka DNA ribosomal RNA (rRNA) ka code rakhta hai. Nucleolus granular aur fibrillar hisson aur DNA par mushtamil hai. Granules pehle se bane ribosomal subunits hain; fibrils ribosome subunits ka khaam (raw) mawad hain, yani rRNA molecules aur un se jure proteins.

blocks.title: Nucleolus ka size aur division
blocks.text: Jo cells bohat zyada protein banate hain, aur is liye bohat se ribosomes chahte hain, un mein nucleolus khasa bara hota hai. Mitosis ke shuru mein cell ka akela nucleolus ghayab ho jata hai, aur division ke baad NORs se naya nucleolus banta hai.
Chromatin aur chromosomes

Nucleus mein dhage jaise fibres hote hain jinhen mila kar chromatin kehte hain, jo DNA aur proteins se bana hai. Chromatin moti (bead) jaisi banawat, nucleosomes, ki ek larri hai; ek nucleosome mein DNA ka dhaga chhote proteins, histones, ke group ke gird lipta hota hai. Interphase ke dauran, jab cell apne aam kaam kar raha hota hai, chromatin poore nucleus mein fibres ke uljhe hue jaal ki soorat mein bikhra hota hai. Jab cell taqseem hone lagta hai to tamam chromatin ke dhage daba kar makhsoos banawat, chromosomes, ban jate hain. Chromosome bazuon (arms), chromatids, aur ek markazi nuqte, centromere, se bana hai.

blocks.alt: Baen se daen teeron se jure chaar marhale: DNA ka double helix; DNA narangi histone moti ke gird lipat kar nucleosomes banata hai; ek kundli-dar (coiled) chromatin fibre; aur X shakal ka chromosome jis ke do chromatids narangi centromere par jure hain.
blocks.caption: Chromatin ka daba kar chromosome banna (Figure 3.14 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: DNA, taqreeban 2 nm chaura, histone proteins ke groups ke gird lipat kar moti jaise nucleosomes banata hai. Yeh moti wali larri kundli ban kar chromatin fibre banati hai jo interphase mein nucleus mein bikhra hota hai. Jab cell taqseem hota hai to fibre daba kar chromosome banta hai jo centromere par jure do chromatids se bana hai. Euchromatin genetically faal (active) hai aur transcribe hota hai; heterochromatin ghair-faal hai.

blocks.title: Chromatin ki do qismein
blocks.text: Euchromatin genetically faal chromatin hai jo proteins banane ke liye RNA transcribe karne mein shamil hai. Heterochromatin doosri qisam hai; is ka DNA genetically ghair-faal hai. Har insani cell ke nucleus mein taqreeban 6 foot DNA hai, jo 46 molecules mein banta hai, har ek taqreeban 1.5 inch lamba, har chromosome ke liye ek.

Kisi jandar ke cells ke nuclei mein chromosomes ki tadaad (number) nasl ke mutabiq makhsoos hoti hai. Insani diploid cells (jo gametes nahin) mein 46 chromosomes hain. Tadaad 2 jitni kam bhi ho sakti hai, jaise kuch cheentiyon (ants) aur roundworms mein, ya hazar se zyada, jaise Indian fern Ophioglossum reticulatum mein, jis mein 1,260 chromosomes hain. Yani kisi nasl mein chromosomes ki tadaad ka jandar ki pecheedgi se koi taalluq nahin.
2. Endoplasmic reticulum (ER)

Endoplasmic reticulum chapte thailon (flattened sacs) aur shakhdar naliyon (branching tubules) ka jaal hai jo poday aur janwar ke cells ke poore cytoplasm mein phaila hai. In thailon aur naliyon ko cisternae (wahid cisterna) kehte hain. Tamam cisternae aapas mein jure hain, is liye ER ka sirf ek bara aur bohat pechdar lumen hai, cisternal space, jo cell ke kul hajm ka 10 fisad se zyada leta hai. Cisternae do-tah nuclear envelope se bhi jure hain, is liye ER nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan ek pipeline deta hai. ER cell ke andar aur bahar istemal ke liye bohat se biochemical compounds banata, process karta aur transport karta hai. Is ki do qismein hain: rough aur smooth.

blocks.title: ER aur nucleus ek hi khana share karte hain
blocks.text: Apne jismani membrane ke jor ki wajah se ER ka lumen aur nuclear envelope ki tahon ke darmiyan ki jagah ek hi khana (compartment) banate hain. Yeh qareebi taalluq ER aur nucleus ko bohat moassar tareeqe se maloomat share karne deta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf nucleus ka hissa. Us ke saath chaar chapte rough ER cisternae ka dher jin par narangi ribosomes lage hain, sab se upar wala nuclear envelope se jari hai. Daen taraf smooth ER ribosomes ke baghair shakhdar naliyon ka jaal hai. Rough ER se ek chhoti vesicle nikalti hai aur teer Golgi apparatus ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Nuclear envelope se jure rough aur smooth endoplasmic reticulum (Figures 3.15 aur 3.16 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Rough ER chapte cisternae ka dher hai jin ki bahari satah par ribosomes hain; yeh proteins banata aur process karta hai aur nuclear envelope ki bahar ki membrane se jari hai. Smooth ER ribosomes ke baghair naliyon ka jaal hai jo lipids banata, calcium zakheera karta aur dawaon ko be-zarar (detoxify) karta hai. Tamam cisternae ek lumen, cisternal space, share karte hain. Transport vesicles ER se nikal kar mahsoolat Golgi apparatus tak le jati hain.

blocks.text: Rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER) ki satah ribosomes se dhaki hai, jis se microscope mein yeh khurdari nazar aati hai. Yeh bunyadi taur par proteins ki tayyari aur processing mein shamil hai. Processing ke dauran RER proteins mein doosre chemicals (jaise sugars) shamil karta hai, phir process-shuda proteins ko cell ke un hisson mein pohanchata hai jahan un ki zaroorat hai, ya mazeed processing aur tabdeeli (modification) ke liye Golgi apparatus ko bhejta hai.

Smooth endoplasmic reticulum (SER) ki satah par ribosomes nahin hote, is liye microscope mein yeh zyada hamwar nazar aata hai. Zyada tar cells mein yeh rough ER se kahin kam phaila hota hai. SER bunyadi taur par lipids banane, carbohydrate metabolism ke building blocks, aur dawaon aur zehron ko be-zarar karne mein shamil hai. Yeh calcium zakheera bhi karta hai aur calcium metabolism karta hai; muscle cells mein SER calcium chhor kar muscle contraction shuru karta hai.

blocks.title: Smooth ER kahan zyada hota hai
blocks.text: Smooth ER un cells mein kahin zyada phaila hota hai jo bohat zyada lipid aur carbohydrate metabolism (dimagh aur muscle) ya detoxification (jigar/liver) karte hain.
3. Ribosomes

Tamam zinda cells mein ribosomes hote hain, nanhi daanedar banawat jo taqreeban 60 fisad ribosomal RNA (rRNA) aur 40 fisad protein se bani hai. Ribosomes membrane mein band nahin hote aur doosre organelles se bohat chhote hain. Eukaryotic cells mein yeh zyada tar rough ER se jure milte hain, kuch azaad bikhre hote hain; prokaryotic cells mein tamam ribosomes cytoplasm mein azaad bikhre hote hain. Ribosomes cell ki protein banane ki machinery hain aur un cells mein sab se zyada hote hain jo protein synthesis mein sargarm hain, jaise pancreas aur dimagh ke cells. Ek aam cell mein kai hazar ribosomes hote hain, magar kuch cell types mein chand million.

Eukaryotic ribosomes nucleolus mein bante aur jure jate hain. Ribosomal proteins nucleolus mein dakhil ho kar rRNA ke dhagon se mil kar do ribosomal subunits banate hain, ek chhota aur ek bara. Subunits nuclear pores se nucleus se nikalte hain, aur cytoplasm mein dono protein synthesis ke liye jur jate hain. Jab protein synthesis nahin ho rahi hoti to dono subunits alag ho jate hain.

Protein synthesis ko rRNA ke ilawa do aur qisam ke RNA molecules ki madad chahiye. Messenger RNA (mRNA) hidayat (instructions) deta hai, jo usne DNA se li hain. Transfer RNA (tRNA) amino acids ribosome tak lata hai. Jab amino acids ki chain ban jati hai to ribosome use chhor deta hai.

blocks.title: Svedberg values
blocks.text: Ribosome ke subunits ko un ki Svedberg (S) values se bayan kiya jata hai, jo centrifuge mein un ke baithne (sedimentation) ki raftar par mabni hain. Mukammal eukaryotic ribosome 80S hai: chhota 40S subunit aur bara 60S subunit. Prokaryotic cells mein 70S ribosomes hote hain, har ek 30S aur 50S subunit ka. Svedberg values jama nahin hotin, kyunke sedimentation ki raftar molecule ke size aur shakal par munhasir hai, sirf molecular weight par nahin.

blocks.title: Azaad aur jure ribosomes; organelles mein ribosomes
blocks.text: Azaad ribosomes ke banaye proteins cell ke apne andaruni istemal ke liye hote hain, jabke RER se jure ribosomes ke banaye proteins cell se bahar bheje jate hain. Ribosomes mitochondria aur podon ke chloroplasts ke andar bhi milte hain; yeh size aur banawat mein cytoplasm ke ribosomes se mukhtalif aur prokaryotes ke ribosomes se zyada milte hain.
4. Mitochondria

Mitochondria (wahid mitochondrion) chhari (rod) ki shakal ke organelles hain jinhen cell ke power generators samjha jata hai. Mitochondrion do membranes mein band hai jin ke darmiyan tang intermembrane space hai; andar ki membrane ke neeche bara andaruni matrix hai. Bahar ki membrane hamwar hai aur chhalni (sieve) ki tarah kaam karti hai, bohat bare molecules ko rok kar. Andar ki membrane bohat pechdar hai aur bohat si andaruni tehain, cristae, banati hai jo satah ka raqba (area) barhati hain. Cristae ki andaruni satah par matrix ki taraf ghundi (knob) jaise ubhaar hote hain, F1 particles; yeh asal mein enzyme ATP synthase hain. Andar ki membrane mein doosre complexes bhi hote hain jo electron transport chain mein electron carriers ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Lambai mein kata chhari-numa mitochondrion: hamwar narangi bahar ki membrane, halki intermembrane space, gehri andar ki membrane jo kai cristae mein muri hai jo cream rang ke matrix mein ubhre hain. Chhoti sabz ghundiyan (F1 particles) cristae par lagi hain; matrix mein circular DNA ka jamni (purple) halqa aur teen narangi ribosomes hain.
blocks.caption: Mitochondrion ki banawat (Figure 3.19 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Bahar ki membrane hamwar aur chhalni jaisi hai. Andar ki membrane cristae mein muri hai jo us ka raqba bohat barhati hain aur F1 particles (ATP synthase) aur electron transport chain rakhti hain. Andar matrix mein Krebs cycle ke enzymes, mitochondrion ka apna circular DNA aur us ke 70S ribosomes hain. Tang intermembrane space dono membranes ke darmiyan hai.

blocks.text: Mitochondria zyada tar doosre organelles se mukhtalif hain: mitochondrion ka apna circular DNA (prokaryotes ke DNA jaisa), har qisam ka RNA aur 70S ribosomes hote hain, aur yeh cell se azaad ho kar replicate kar sakta hai. Mitochondria cellular respiration ki jagah hain. Yeh oxygen aur ghizai ajza se adenosine triphosphate (ATP) banate hain; ATP tawanai ki chemical "currency" hai jo cell ki metabolic sargarmiyan chalati hai. Matrix ke enzymes cellular respiration ke kuch marhale, jaise Krebs cycle, chalate hain; electron transport chain ke proteins andar ki membrane mein hain.

blocks.title: Kitne, aur kahan
blocks.text: Kisi cell mein mitochondria ki tadaad us ki metabolic zaroorat par munhasir hai aur ek se hazaron tak hoti hai. Mitochondria taqreeban tamam eukaryotes (poday, janwar, fungi aur protists) mein milte hain aur itne bare hain ke light microscope se dekhe ja sakte hain. Scientists ka khayal hai ke karoron saal pehle chhote azaad prokaryotes ko bare prokaryotes ne nigal liya magar hazam nahin kiya; dono mein symbiotic rishta ban gaya, bara ghiza deta aur chhota ATP.
5. Chloroplasts

Podon ki sab se aham khususiyat mein se ek photosynthesis karne ki salahiyat hai, yani roshni ki tawanai ko chemical tawanai mein badal kar apni ghiza khud banana. Yeh taqreeban tamam podon mein hota hai aur makhsoos organelles, chloroplasts, mein anjam pata hai. Podon ke tamam sabz hisse, tanay aur kachay phal samet, chloroplasts rakhte hain, magar zyada tar podon mein zyada tar photosynthesis patton mein hoti hai. Ausatan ek patte ki satah par chloroplast ki density taqreeban paanch lakh fi muraba millimetre hai. Chloroplasts mein chlorophyll a aur chlorophyll b pigments hote hain jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni ki tawanai jazb (absorb) karte hain.

blocks.title: Yaad karen: plastids
blocks.text: Podon aur bohat se protists ke cells mein teen qisam ke plastids hote hain: chloroplasts, chromoplasts aur leucoplasts. Be-rang leucoplasts zakheera karne mein shamil hain; peele se surkh chromoplasts poday ke hisson ko rang dete hain.

Baizavi (ellipsoid) chloroplast do membranes mein band hai, jin ke darmiyan intermembrane space hai. Andar ki membrane ke andar ek neem-rawan madda, stroma, hai; is mein hal-shuda enzymes hain aur yeh chloroplast ke zyada tar hajm par mushtamil hai. Bahar ki membrane andar wali se kahin zyada guzarne-dene wali hai. Andar ki membranes ek doosre ke qareeb hoti hain aur apne kinaron par mil jati hain, is tarah do saath wali membranes disc jaisa khana, thylakoid, banati hain. Bohat se thylakoids dher bana kar grana (wahid granum) banate hain; lamellae woh ghair-sabz khane hain jo do grana ko jorte hain. Har granum mein chand se kai thylakoids ho sakte hain, aur ek chloroplast mein sau ya zyada grana. Mitochondrion ki tarah chloroplast ka apna DNA hai aur yeh cell se azaad ho kar afzaish karta hai.

blocks.alt: Lambai mein kata baizavi chloroplast: sabz bahar ki membrane, halki intermembrane space, andar ki membrane aur halka sabz stroma. Andar chapti discs ke teen dher (grana) hain jo patli lamellae se jure hain, circular DNA ka jamni halqa aur chand narangi ribosomes.
blocks.caption: Chloroplast ki banawat (Figure 3.20 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Do membranes chloroplast ko ghere hain jin ke darmiyan intermembrane space hai; bahar ki membrane andar wali se zyada guzarne-dene wali hai. Stroma andar ka enzymes wala rawan madda hai jahan carbon dioxide glucose mein badalti hai. Thylakoids disc jaise khane hain jo mili hui andaruni membranes se bante hain; thylakoids ke dher grana hain, aur lamellae ek granum ko agle se jorti hain. Thylakoids mein chlorophyll a aur b roshni jazb karte hain. Chloroplast ka apna circular DNA aur ribosomes hain.

blocks.text: Roshni thylakoid discs mein jare chlorophyll molecules jazb karte hain. Jab yeh chlorophyll molecules roshni jazb karte hain to electrons chhorte hain, aur is tarah ATP banta hai. Is ATP ko istemal kar ke, stroma mein, kam-tawanai carbon dioxide glucose jaise zyada-tawanai compound mein badal jati hai.

blocks.title: Mitochondria aur chloroplasts ka muqabla
blocks.text: Dono cell ke liye tawanai badalte hain. Mitochondria aerobic respiration karte hain, oxygen ki madad se sugars, fats aur doosre eendhan (fuels) ko metabolise kar ke ATP banate hain. Chloroplasts photosynthesis karte hain, sooraj ki tawanai ko carbon dioxide aur pani se organic ghiza mein badalte hain. Dono apna DNA rakhte hain aur cell se azaad ho kar barhte aur afzaish karte hain.
6. Golgi apparatus

Golgi apparatus paanch se aath pyali (cup) jaise, membrane se dhake thailon, cisternae, par mushtamil hai jo ek doosre par dher hain. Yeh podon, janwaron aur yak-khalvi eukaryotes ke cells mein milta hai. Kuch yak-khalvi flagellates mein Golgi apparatus 60 cisternae ka ho sakta hai, aur ek cell mein Golgi apparatuses ki tadaad us ke kaam ke mutabiq badalti hai; janwar ke cells mein aam taur par das se bees Golgi stacks hote hain. Yeh complex aam taur par nucleus ke qareeb hota hai. Har Golgi stack ke do alag rukh (faces) hain: cis face endoplasmic reticulum ke qareeb hai, aur trans face plasma membrane ke qareeb.

Golgi apparatus cell ki chemical mahsoolat ka taqseem aur tarseel (shipping) ka shoba hai. Yeh ER mein bane proteins aur lipids ko badal kar unhen cell se bahar export karne ya cell ke doosre hisson mein bhejne ke liye tayyar karta hai. Proteins, carbohydrates, phospholipids aur doosre molecules wali chhoti vesicles ER se nikal kar cytoplasm mein chalti hain yahan tak ke Golgi apparatus ke cis face tak pohanchti hain, jahan woh mil jati hain aur apne molecules us mein chhor deti hain. Yahan compounds mazeed process hote hain: Golgi lumen ke enzymes unhen glycoproteins aur glycolipids mein badal dete hain.

blocks.alt: Upar rough ER do chhoti vesicles neeche paanch khameeda cisternae ke dher ke cis face ko bhejta hai. Neeche trans face se secretory vesicles nikalti hain; ek plasma membrane se mil kar apna mawad bahar chhorti hai, doosri lysosome ban jati hai.
blocks.caption: Golgi apparatus ki banawat aur us ka kaam (Figure 3.21 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Transport vesicles rough ER se nikal kar Golgi stack ke cis face se milti hain. Mawad paanch se aath pyali jaise cisternae se guzarta hai, jahan enzymes use glycoproteins aur glycolipids mein badalte hain. Plasma membrane ke qareeb trans face par mahsoolat vesicles mein pack hoti hain: secretions exocytosis se cell se bahar jati hain, doosri mahsoolat ER ko wapas jati hain ya pak kar lysosomes banti hain.

blocks.text: Mahsool trans face se vesicle mein nikalti hai aur cell ke andar ya bahar apni aakhri manzil ko bheji jati hai. Export hone wali mahsoolat ko secretions kehte hain. Doosri mahsoolat ER ko wapas ki jati hain ya pak kar lysosomes ban sakti hain. Poday ke cells mein Golgi apparatus pectin aur doosre polysaccharides bhi banata hai jo poday ki banawat aur metabolism ke liye zaroori hain.

blocks.title: Yaad karen: Camillo Golgi
blocks.text: Camillo Golgi nayi staining technique (Golgi staining) se nervous system parh rahe the ke unhon ne cells ke andar ek banawat dekhi aur use reticular apparatus ka naam diya. Unhon ne 1898 mein apni daryaft ka elan kiya aur banawat ka naam un ke naam par rakha gaya. Bohat se scientists kehte rahe ke yeh staining se paida hui nazar ki ghalati hai; beesvin sadi mein electron microscope ne aakhir sabit kiya ke Golgi apparatus ek asli organelle hai.
7. Lysosomes

Lysosomes ek membrane mein band gol organelles hain. Yeh cell ke hazam karne wale khane hain aur zyada tar eukaryotic cells mein milte hain. Janwaron mein yeh beemari se larne wale cells, jaise white blood cells, mein sab se zyada hote hain, jinhen bacteria, viruses aur doosre ajnabi hamla-awar hazam karne hote hain. Lysosomes cell ke un maddon ko bhi torte hain jin ki umar poori ho chuki ya jo ab kaam ke nahin: yeh autophagy hai. Yeh cell ke fuzla, fats, carbohydrates, proteins aur doosre macromolecules ko saada compounds mein torte hain, jo naya mawad banane ke liye cytoplasm mein wapas bheje jate hain.

Lysosomes mein taqreeban 40 mukhtalif hydrolytic enzymes hote hain, sab ER mein bante aur Golgi apparatus mein badle jate hain. Lysosome ki membrane ki tah baqi cell ko in sakht hazam karne wale enzymes se bachati hai, jo warna bara nuqsan pohanchate.

blocks.title: Yaad karen: de Duve, aur cell mehfooz kyun hai
blocks.text: Lysosomes Belgian scientist Christian René de Duve ne daryaft kiye. Jigar ke cells mein carbohydrate metabolism parhte hue unhon ne dekha ke centrifuge mein tootne wale cells acid phosphatase chhorte hain, aur tajweez kiya ke yeh hazam karne wala enzyme ek membrane mein band organelle mein hai, jise unhon ne lysosome ka naam diya. Lysosome ke enzymes ko tezabi (acidic) mahol (pH taqreeban 4.8) chahiye. Lysosomal matrix tezabi hai magar cytosol neutral hai, is liye agar lysosome phat bhi jaye to us ke enzymes ghair-faal ho jate hain aur cell mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.title: Lysosomal storage diseases
blocks.text: In beemariyon mein mareez mein lysosome ka koi ek hydrolytic enzyme nahin hota, is liye ghair-mamooli lysosome na hazam hone wale maddon se bhar jata hai jo cell ke kaamon mein rukawat dalte hain. Pompe's disease mein lysosome mein glycogen hazam karne wala enzyme nahin hota, is liye jigar ke cells mein nuqsan-deh miqdar mein glycogen jama ho jata hai. Tay-Sachs disease mein ek zaroori lipid hazam karne wala enzyme nahin hota; dimagh ke nerve cells mein lipids jama ho kar nervous system ko nuqsan pohanchate hain, zehni pasmandgi aur bachpan mein maut ka sabab bante hain.

Lysosomes poore cell ko khatam karne mein bhi kaam karte hain. Chun kar cell ki maut kaseer-khalvi jandaron ki numu ka ek tareeqa hai: jab tadpole mendak banta hai to dum ke cells lysosome ke enzymes se tabah ho jate hain. Dimagh ke bohat se cells numu ke dauran marte hain; yeh hidayat-shuda khudkushi un cells ke andar lysosomes ke phatne se anjam pati hai jinhen khatam kiya ja raha hai.
8. Peroxisomes

Peroxisomes tamam eukaryotic cells mein ek membrane mein band organelles hain, jo Christian de Duve ne daryaft kiye, jinhon ne lysosomes bhi daryaft kiye the. Peroxisomes mein mukhtalif enzymes hote hain, bohat se oxidative, jo oxidation (electrons aur hydrogens ka nikalna) karte hain. Yeh enzymes bunyadi taur par cell ko zehreele maddon se paak karte hain; maslan jigar ke cells ke peroxisomes alcohol aur doosre nuqsan-deh compounds ko oxidise kar ke be-zarar karte hain. Kuch peroxisomes mein catalase hota hai, jo hydrogen peroxide (cell ke metabolism ki ek aam zaili paidawar) ko pani aur oxygen mein tor deta hai.

blocks.title: Zellweger syndrome
blocks.text: Peroxisomes ki kharabi kai metabolic beemariyan paida karti hai. Sab se sangeen Zellweger syndrome hai, jis mein cells mein peroxisomes nahin hote ya kam hote hain. Yeh paidaishi (congenital) hai, is ka koi ilaj ya moassar treatment nahin, aur aam taur par pehle saal ke andar maut ka sabab banti hai.
9. Glyoxysomes

Glyoxysomes peroxisomes jaise hain magar sirf poday ke cells mein milte hain. In mein woh enzymes hote hain jo lipids ko carbohydrates mein badalte hain. Yeh lipid se bharpoor beejon, jaise castor beans aur soya beans, ke cells mein sab se zyada hote hain; beej phootne (germination) ke dauran yeh zakheera-shuda lipids ko carbohydrates mein badalte hain jo beej phootne ke liye tawanai dete hain.
10. Vacuoles

Vacuoles membrane mein band thaile hain jo kai tarah kaam karte hain. Pukhta poday ke cells mein ek bari vacuole banawat ka sahara deti hai aur zakheera, fuzla nikalne, hifazat aur numu mein kaam aati hai. Janwar ke cells mein vacuoles bohat chhoti hoti hain aur zyada tar mawad ko kuch dair zakheera karne ya cheezen le jane ke liye istemal hoti hain. Bohat se poday ke cells mein ek bari, akeli central vacuole hoti hai, jo chhoti vacuoles ke milne se aahista banti hai aur cell ki zyada tar jagah (80 fisad ya zyada) leti hai. Yeh tonoplast naami membrane mein band hai, aur andar ka mawad cell sap hai, jo gird ke cytoplasm se numayan taur par mukhtalif hai.

Central vacuole poday ke liye ek aham banawati kirdar ada karti hai jo turgor pressure qaboo karne ki us ki salahiyat se jura hai; turgor pressure cell ko sakhti deta hai. Behtareen halaat mein poday ko kafi pani milta hai aur us ke cells ki central vacuoles pani jama hone se phool jati hain, jo ooncha turgor pressure banata hai aur cell wall ke sahare ke saath poday ki banawat ko qaim rakhta hai. Vacuoles aksar woh pigments bhi zakheera karti hain jo kuch phoolon ko rang dete hain, jo shehad ki makkhiyon aur doosre pollinators ko khenchte hain, aur woh aise molecules bhi chhorti hain jo mukhtalif keeron aur janwaron ke liye zehreele hain, taake woh poday ko na khayen.

blocks.title: Yaad karen: vacuoles
blocks.text: Vacuoles pani se bhari, ek membrane mein band organelles hain. Cells ke cytoplasm mein bohat si chhoti vacuoles hoti hain; jab poday ka cell pukhta hota hai to us ki chhoti vacuoles mil kar ek bari vacuole banati hain. Poday ki vacuoles mein zakheera kai maddey insanon ke kaam ke hain, jaise afeem (opium), rubber aur lehsan (garlic) ka zaiqa.
11. Centrioles

Janwaron aur zyada tar protists ke cells mein centrioles woh organelles hain jo cytoskeleton ke fibres, microtubules (spindle fibres samet), ko jorne aur tarteeb dene se jure hain. Eukaryotic cells mein centrioles joron mein hote hain, dono nuclear envelope ke qareeb ek doosre se seedhe zaviye par. Cilia ya flagella wale cells mein centrioles cilia aur flagella banane mein shamil hain: har cilium aur flagellum ek centriole se jura hai jise basal body kehte hain. Podon aur fungi ke cells mein centrioles aur basal bodies nahin hote; un ke microtubules aur spindle fibres cytoplasm ki banawat se tarteeb pate hain.

blocks.title: Yaad karen: centriole ki banawat
blocks.text: Centrioles khokhle (hollow) aur belan (cylinder) jaise organelles hain. Ek centriole microtubules ke nau (nine) triplets se bana hai.
12. Cytoskeleton
Cytoskeleton cytoplasm mein protein fibres ka jaal hai. Is mein teen qisam ke fibres hain.

items: Microfilaments: tamam eukaryotic cells mein hote hain. Yeh globular protein actin ki thos charhiyan hain. Microfilaments tootte aur dobara jurte hain, jis se cells shakal badalte aur chalte hain; yeh taqseem hote cell ko do cells mein chutki (pinch) de kar alag karne dete hain, aur myosin ke saath mil kar cell ke sukarne (contraction) mein madad karte hain.

Microtubules: seedhe, khokhle belan jo subunits se bane hain, har subunit do mukhtalif tubulin proteins, alpha-tubulin aur beta-tubulin, se bana hai. Microtubules cell ko banawat aur shakal dete hain aur organelles ke transport ke liye shahrahon (highways) ka kaam karte hain. Yeh cilia aur flagella ke bare ajza hain aur cell division ke dauran spindle fibres banane mein shamil hote hain.

Intermediate filaments: sirf kuch aala janwar groups mein milte hain. Yeh mukhtalif proteins se bane hain, sab se aam subunit vimentin hai; kuch cells mein doosre proteins ke intermediate filaments hote hain, maslan jild (skin) ke cells mein keratin. Intermediate filaments cell ki shakal aur sakhti qaim rakhte hain aur nucleus samet kai organelles ko jamaye rakhte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen fibres saath-saath. Baen, microfilament: narangi actin motiyon ki marori hui zanjeer. Darmiyan, microtubule: khokhla belan jo baari-baari neele alpha-tubulin aur jamni beta-tubulin subunits se bana hai. Daen, intermediate filament: teen marore hue sabz protein dhagon ki rassi. Har ek ke kaam neeche likhe hain.
blocks.caption: Cytoskeleton ke teen fibres (Figure 3.27 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Microfilaments actin ki thos charhiyan hain, taqreeban 7 nm chauri; yeh cell ki shakal badalte, cell ko chalate, taqseem hote cell ko do mein kaat-te aur myosin ke saath sukarte hain. Microtubules alpha- aur beta-tubulin ke khokhle belan hain, taqreeban 25 nm chaure; yeh shakal dete, organelles ke liye shahrah bante, cilia aur flagella banate aur spindle banate hain. Intermediate filaments vimentin ya keratin jaise fibrous proteins ki rassiyan hain, taqreeban 10 nm chauri; yeh shakal aur sakhti qaim rakhte aur nucleus samet organelles ko jamaye rakhte hain, aur sirf kuch janwar groups mein milte hain.

blocks.text: 13. Cilia aur flagella

Cilium (jama cilia) aur flagellum (jama flagella) harkat ke zamaim (locomotor appendages) hain jo kuch cells se bahar nikle hote hain: patle, dum jaise ubhaar jo cell ke jism se phaile hain. Cilia chhote aur aam taur par bohat se hote hain; flagella lambe magar kam. Cilia podon mein kam hain. Bohat se protozoans (ciliates) cilia rakhte hain, aur bare eukaryotes jaise mammals ke kuch cells ki satah par cilia hote hain; insanon mein cilia trachea ke andar hote hain, jahan woh saans ki naliyon se balgham (mucus) aur mitti bahar jharte hain.

Eukaryotic cilium ya flagellum ka markaz axoneme hai. Is mein do markazi microtubules hain jin ke gird nau doublet microtubules ka bahari halqa hai. Axoneme ke gird dynein molecules saath wale doublets ke darmiyan ka fasla paat-te hain. Biologists is tarteeb ko "9 + 2" banawat kehte hain. Poore axoneme ke gird plasma membrane hai. Cilium ki jar par us ka tarteeb dene wala markaz, basal body, hai, jis ki bunyadi banawat axoneme ke bahari halqe jaisi hai siwaye is ke ke nau bahari sets mein se har ek doublet ki bajaye microtubules ka triplet hai. Basal body asal mein centriole hai. Prokaryotic flagella ki banawat bilkul mukhtalif hai, jo protein flagellin se bani hai.

blocks.alt: Baen, apni plasma membrane ke andar cilium ka cross-section: halqe mein microtubules ke nau jore (neele aur jamni) jin ke darmiyan narangi dynein arms hain, aur darmiyan mein do akele sabz microtubules. Daen, basal body ka cross-section: halqe mein microtubules ke nau triplets aur markazi jora nahin.
blocks.caption: Eukaryotic cilium ya flagellum ka 9 + 2 axoneme, aur us ki basal body (Figures 3.26 aur 3.28 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Axoneme mein do markazi akele microtubules ke gird nau bahari doublet microtubules hain, dynein arms saath wale doublets ko jorte hain, aur sab plasma membrane mein band hai. Jar par basal body ek centriole hai: microtubules ke nau triplets aur markazi jora nahin, khokhli aur belan jaisi; centrioles nucleus ke qareeb seedhe zaviye par joron mein hote hain. Prokaryotic flagellum mukhtalif hai, microtubules ke baghair flagellin ka filament.

blocks.prompt: Inhen ek membrane, do membrane aur be-membrane banawat mein baanten: ribosome, lysosome, mitochondrion, Golgi apparatus, chloroplast, centriole, peroxisome, nucleus, vacuole.
blocks.explanation: Ek membrane: lysosome, Golgi apparatus, peroxisome, vacuole. Do membranes: mitochondrion, chloroplast, nucleus. Koi membrane nahin: ribosome, centriole.

blocks.prompt: Ek secretory protein ka rasta us ke banne se cell se nikalne tak tarteeb se banawat ke naam le kar bayan karen.
blocks.explanation: Rough ER par ribosomes protein banate hain, jo cisternal space mein dakhil ho kar wahan process hota hai (sugars shamil). Yeh transport vesicle mein Golgi apparatus ke cis face tak jata hai, cisternae se guzarte hue glycoprotein mein badalta hai, trans face par secretory vesicle mein pack hota hai, aur vesicle plasma membrane se mil kar exocytosis se secretion bahar chhorti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Cell wall: middle lamella (pectates) pehle banti hai, primary wall (cellulose, hemicellulose, pectin), kuch cells mein secondary wall (lignin); plasmodesmata parosi poday ke cells ko jorte hain. Fungi chitin, bacteria peptidoglycan, diatoms silica istemal karte hain.

Plasma membrane (fluid mosaic model, Singer aur Nicolson 1972): phospholipid bilayer jis mein proteins tairte hain, rawani ke liye cholesterol, pehchan ke nishan ke taur par glycoproteins aur glycolipids (glycocalyx); neem-masamdar rukawat.

Nucleus: pore complexes wali do-tah envelope, nuclear lamina, nucleoplasm, chromatin (histones par DNA, nucleosomes) jo chromosomes (chromatids aur centromere) mein dabta hai, nucleolus jo NORs par ribosomal subunits banata hai. Chromosomes ki tadaad nasl ke mutabiq hai aur pecheedgi se juri nahin.

ER: rough (ribosomes, proteins) aur smooth (lipids, detoxification, calcium); ek cisternal space jo nuclear envelope se jari hai. Ribosomes: rRNA aur protein, eukaryotes mein 80S (40S + 60S), prokaryotes mein 70S (30S + 50S).

Mitochondria (cristae, F1 particles, matrix, apna DNA, 70S ribosomes) respiration se ATP banate hain; chloroplasts (thylakoids, grana, lamellae, stroma, apna DNA) photosynthesis se glucose banate hain.

Golgi apparatus mahsoolat badalta aur bhejta hai (cis se trans); lysosomes hazam karte hain (taqreeban 40 enzymes, tezabi); peroxisomes zehreele madde oxidise karte hain (catalase); glyoxysomes beejon mein lipids ko carbohydrates banate hain; vacuoles zakheera aur turgor deti hain.

Centrioles (nau triplets, seedhe zaviye par jore) microtubules tarteeb dete aur basal bodies ke taur par cilia aur flagella ko jamate hain; cytoskeleton mein microfilaments (actin), microtubules (tubulin) aur intermediate filaments (vimentin, keratin) hain; cilia aur flagella ka 9 + 2 axoneme hai.
